doc.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026

title: Forest Song and silent meditation in a Thai monastery
summary: Parsons wrote Forest Song at a Buddhist monastery in Thailand during silent meditation, an experience of realization he has since repeated.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: No “Forest Song” was a different one. “Forest Song” was something I wrote while I was in a monastery in Thailand doing my two weeks of silent meditation.
What came out of that experience?

It’s the best thing I ever did for myself. That I grew up, my father was superintendent of the Sunday school so I grew up a church boy and all this kind of stuff, but being in the martial arts and Eastern ways, and being interested in Eastern ways, I wanted to experience doing that, being in a Buddhist monastery and doing that just to see what it was about. It was just kind of, how do I say, an adventure, a kind of fantasy and all that. So I went, you know it was 95 degrees every day, no air conditioning out there and you don’t speak you just only speak with the teacher for about twenty minutes a day and other than that you’re in silent meditation. And so it was really miserable for the first four days, but by day five it went from being miserable to wonderful. It was like it didn’t matter

anymore that it was hot. It didn’t matter that I could do my physical exercises and the sweat would be so much it would wet the floor. It just didn’t matter anymore. I was going towards something else. And on day eleven I was in lying down meditation, it was the evening of day eleven, and I jumped up because the realization is that these teachings, this is what Jesus was telling us. And that was a revelation. And so this is how I learned to start looking at myself almost in the third person, so I can see if this emotion is really relevant to me, is this what is going to actually help me, or this, or that. You know and things like anger and jealousy or hatred and all, to try to banish these things from my life.
So the last thing on my bucket list was to go back there. So I did that and it was so good that I did it summer before last and it was so good I did it again last summer.
It’s working for you. That’s very clear.
Yes. Yeah my wife is really happy about it. She says that she enjoys the person who comes from that.
